entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I hope you can help. I'm a bit confused. I have an item I bought... a shirt, I think? I'm just not sure what to do.
I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have an order number handy?
Um, yes, I think so. Let me see... it's VF8675309.
Great, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order right here for the Pro-Cycle Jersey. What specifically is the issue with the jersey?

The jersey, right. Well, I finally tried it on and it's just... not right. I must have ordered the wrong size because it's way too tight across the chest. I don't know, your website has so many options, I get overwhelmed.
I understand. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a larger size, correct?
Yes, an exchange would be great! But I've had it for a while, I only just found it again. I was looking at the website for the rules and it was all so complicated. Can't you just help me?

Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me just check the delivery date... I see it was delivered 81 days ago. That's perfectly fine. For our standard apparel, VeloFit has a 90-day return and exchange policy.
Oh, really? So it's not a problem? I was so worried I was stuck with it. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all, you're well within the window. I've just initiated the exchange process in our system. I am sending you an email right now with a prepaid return label. Just print that out, place the original jersey in a mailer, and drop it off. As soon as we see it's on its way back, we'll ship the new size out to you.
Wow, that's it? That sounds so much simpler than I thought. Thank you so much, Sarah!
You are very welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that was everything. You've been a great help.
I'm happy to hear that. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
